autonomous organization of education Nazarbayev University (hereinafter - the Rules)
determine the procedure for visiting and using the facilities of the Sports Complex
“Nazarbayev University”, and also regulate the norms of behavior of persons visiting
the facilities of the Sports Complex “Nazarbayev University”, and are aimed at
ensuring internal order, in order to:
1) Nazarbayev University effectively operate;
2) ensure proper order on the territory of the facilities of the Sports Complex
“Nazarbayev University”;

facilities of the Sports Complex “Nazarbayev University” for effective training and
achieving positive sports and health results.

— the Sport Complex) to which these Rules apply are Multifunctional sport and
recreation complex,
including outdoor summer sport fields, the Athletic and Sport
Centers, located at: Nur-Sultan city, Kabanbay Batyr avenue 53.

membership or a one-time ticket in order to engage in sport and fitness and health
recreational activities.
4.
The Rules requirements are universal, obligatory and apply to all persons
visiting the facilities of the Sports Complex “Nazarbayev University”.
